description: This file defines a React component for a navigation menu in the Notesnook application, including route handling, UI elements, drag-and-drop reordering, and user interaction features.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main React component rendering the navigation menu with tabs, routes, colors, shortcuts, and user profile dropdown.

methods.name: Routes
methods.description: Component rendering the list of route items with drag-and-drop reordering.

methods.name: RouteItem
methods.description: Component representing a single route item in the navigation, with drop handling and menu options.

methods.name: Colors
methods.description: Component rendering the list of color items with reordering and context menu.

methods.name: ColorItem
methods.description: Component representing a single color item with options to rename or remove.

methods.name: Shortcuts
methods.description: Component rendering user shortcuts with reordering.

methods.name: ShortcutItem
methods.description: Component representing a single shortcut item with navigation and removal options.

methods.name: ItemCount
methods.description: Displays count of notes, reminders, or other items related to a route or color.

methods.name: NavigationDropdown
methods.description: User profile button with menu for theme toggle, upgrade, settings, and login/logout.

methods.name: ReorderableList
methods.description: Generic component enabling drag-and-drop reordering of list items.

methods.name: orderItems
methods.description: Utility to order items based on a saved order array.

methods.name: toMenuItems
methods.description: Converts list of items into menu item objects with feature checks.

methods.name: navigateToRoute
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specific route, toggling list pane or resetting search as needed.
